visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: StringBuilder Instead of Repeated Concatenation
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A String is rebuilt by prepending one character at a time. Use StringBuilder's reverse method. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Strings are immutable, so every concatenation in the loop creates a new String and copies the old one. StringBuilder changes one buffer in place, and reverse() is already written and tested.
